name: Can I use large format tiles in a small shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I use large format tiles in a small shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, large format tiles can be used in a small shower and often create an illusion of a larger space due to fewer grout lines. However, careful planning and precise cuts are essential. The installer must ensure proper slope to the drain, especially on the shower floor, as large tiles can be more challenging to manipulate for drainage. For shower floors, smaller tiles or mosaics are often preferred because their numerous grout lines provide better grip and are easier to slope towards the drain. Consult with your contractor to determine if large format tiles are suitable for your specific small shower design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, large format tiles can be used in small showers to create a sense of space, but careful planning and installation are crucial. Smaller tiles are often preferred for shower floors for better grip and drainage.
